note: Day 5 blind holdout for the binding router (docs/plans/2026-09-15-core-pro-development.md). Written BEFORE e90_binding_router.py was first run, and not tuned against. Distinct from the three published fixtures, which are regression sets: this one covers the seven classes the plan names — different owners, different objects, nonoverlapping time intervals, unit conversions, quantifier scope, negated predicates, paraphrases — plus the implication class E84 measured the rules failing on (0/3). Labels are the ground truth for 'these two statements contradict each other'; 'false' does NOT mean 'unrelated', it means 'not a contradiction'.

classes.different-owner: same predicate, different owner — not comparable
classes.different-object: same owner, different object — not comparable
classes.nonoverlapping-time: contradictory predicates, disjoint intervals — not comparable
classes.unit-conversion: same quantity in different units — agreement; a real difference in the same unit is a contradiction
classes.quantifier-scope: universal vs negative-universal is agreement; universal vs existential denial is contradiction
classes.negated-predicate: an explicit negation of the same predicate is a contradiction
classes.paraphrase: same meaning, different words — not a contradiction
classes.implication: entailment and excluded middle; the class E84 measured the rules failing on
